DB.description: D1 database that stores the bookmarks and their tags. Created automatically.

SITE_TITLE.description: Name shown in the top bar and on the home screen icon.

TAG_MODEL.description: Claude model used for tag suggestions. Only used when the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` secret is set.

ICON_SERVICE.description: Optional. A public icon service to ask when a site's own icon cannot be found, for example `https://icons.duckduckgo.com/ip3/{domain}.ico`. It learns the domains of your pinned bookmarks. Leave empty to keep it off.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. An Anthropic API key turns on tag suggestions for new bookmarks. Leave empty to keep them off.
